script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

BETH (30s), a discontented accountant, sits alone at a table, staring at her laptop. She sighs, closes it, and glances around the bustling coffee shop. Her gaze lands on FRED (50s), a quirky, eccentric man, who's busily painting a watercolor landscape.

BETH
(to herself)
What do I have to lose?

She gathers her things and approaches Fred.

BETH
Excuse me, do you ever teach art classes?

FRED
(looks up from his painting, smiles)
I do indeed, dear lady. Why not give it a try?

EXT. ART STUDIO - DAY (Later)

Beth stands in front of a blank canvas, surrounded by paintbrushes, tubes of paint, and Fred's gentle guidance. She hesitates, then dips a brush in red paint and makes a bold stroke.

BETH
(muttering)
I can do this.

INT. COFFICE - DAY (Present)

Beth sits at her desk, surrounded by stacks of paperwork. She glances at her laptop, then at the window, longing for her newfound passion.

BETH
(to herself)
What am I still doing here?

INT. ART CLASSROOM - NIGHT

Beth stands in front of a room filled with students, all eagerly painting their canvases. She feels alive.

BETH
Remember, color and emotion go hand in hand. Don't be afraid to express yourself!

The students laugh and nod in agreement. Beth smiles and begins to paint.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY (Later)

Beth meets with her former boss, GORDON (40s), who's clearly surprised by her unexpected resignation.

GORDON
But you're such a valuable asset, Beth.

BETH
(smiling)
I know, but I've found something that brings me joy. I can't let that go.

Gordon sighs, understandingly.

GORDON
All right, Beth. I wish you the best.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT (Opening)

Beth stands in the midst of her first art show, surrounded by admiring guests. Fred is there, proudly holding up a business card, announcing his new student's success.

BETH
(smiling)
I couldn't have done it without you, Fred.

FRED
Nonsense, Beth. You had the talent inside you all along.

INT. ART STUDIO - DAY (Present)

Beth paints in her studio, surrounded by her creations. She looks up, a contented smile on her face.

FADE OUT.

The end.
